description: A structure satisfies the specified successor sentence exactly when successor never gives zero, successor is injective, and the specified map taking \(n\) to the value of its numeral is surjective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorSentence_realize.{w} (M : Type w)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorLanguage.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorSentence.Realize M ↔
    (∀ (x : M),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.succValue M x ≠
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.zeroValue M) ∧
      Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.succValue M) ∧
        Function.Surjective (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.numeralValue M)
